checks.explanation: D-selection is printed on page 1, the same page as the start of the itemized prices, which counts as correctly placed.
The includesText names arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
No other mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead appears on the list besides the basic services fee.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the embalming price is on page 1, which counts as in immediate conjunction.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2, which counts as in immediate conjunction.
No text states a casket is required for direct cremation; purchaser-provided container and alternative containers are offered.
The direct cremation description lists transportation to crematory and states the crematory charge is a cash advance item, so it is clear it is not included.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have itemized prices, and no other offered good or service lacks its own line.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
The only require-by-cemetery language is the prescribed outer burial container disclosure wording, which is not a concern.
No text claims long-term preservation or protection from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and no required disclosure is shown as hard to notice.
